message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h3/src/h3lib/lib && cat -n algos.c | sed -n '344,356p'` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The vulnerable lines are 350-351:
- Line 350: `H3_SET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r + 1, NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]);`
- Line 351: `nextDir = NEW_ADJUSTMENT_II[oldDigit][dir];`

When `oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT` (7), `NEW_DIGIT_II[7][dir]` and `NEW_ADJUSTMENT_II[7][dir]` are out of bounds.

Let me verify the exact line numbers with `cat -n`.
